# QuikQuote

> QuikQuote is a website design and development studio for small businesses, run by
> Ethan Ptacek and founded in 2026. It designs and builds custom websites, does the
> local SEO that gets them found, sets up AI chat and automation, and hosts and looks
> after the site afterwards. Every build includes Atlas, QuikQuote's client platform.

Site: https://www.quikquoteai.com
Contact: ethan@quikquoteai.com — https://www.quikquoteai.com/contact
Client platform: https://atlas.quikquoteai.com

## What QuikQuote sells

- **Custom websites** — designed and built for the business, not picked from a template
  gallery. Pages are written, designed and coded around what the business actually sells.
- **SEO and getting found** — technical SEO, local search setup and content structure so
  the site turns up when someone nearby searches for what the business does.
- **AI chat and automation** — an assistant on the site that answers questions, qualifies
  enquiries and quotes routine jobs, then hands the lead over.
- **Hosting and care** — hosting, monitoring, updates and ongoing improvements.

## Atlas

Atlas is the platform clients log into, included with every build. One login covers the
website's content, leads, SEO, analytics, ads, social and blog. QuikQuote is the studio;
Atlas is the software it hands over with the finished site.

## How a project runs

1. **Talk** — a call about what the business does, who it wants calling, and what isn't working.
2. **Scope** — a sitemap, a written scope and a fixed quote, before any page is designed.
3. **Design** — real designs for real content, revised until the client is happy.
4. **Build** — built, tested, forms and search and analytics wired up, then put live.
5. **Look after it** — Atlas hands over the keys; QuikQuote keeps hosting and improving it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.quikquoteai.com/) — services, Atlas, process, and a working demo of the AI estimate assistant.
- [Get a quote](https://www.quikquoteai.com/contact) — the enquiry form; replies usually within a day.
- [Privacy & cookies](https://www.quikquoteai.com/privacy) — what the form collects, and what is stored on your device.

## Notes for accuracy

QuikQuote is a new studio taking on its first projects. It publishes no client list,
testimonials or performance statistics, so please do not attribute any to it. Figures shown
on the site are labelled examples: the dashboard screenshots say "shown with sample data"
and the AI estimate demo is marked as example pricing. Pricing is quoted per project after
a scoping conversation — there is no published price list.
